newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei ends sharply down but off lows.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei ends sharply down but off lows.

text.p: The Simex Nikkei futures ended sharply lower but off intraday lows on Monday.
Dealers said the futures market ended weaker following the cash market. "I think there is also some profit taking ahead of the Tankan report," said a dealer with a European bank.
September Nikkei ended at 20,920 after touching a low of 20,890 against 21,245 on Friday. Volume was 18,120 contracts.

A dealer said there should be some technical support for the September contract on the downside at 20,800 and trading is expected to remain light until after the Tankan report due Wednesday. - Doreen Siow (65-8703092)
